name: The Listening Pit and the Gates

pages.title: Placement is the ...
pages.text:
Devices that claim to be rites have to be arranged, not scattered.\
Seven shapes, all rotation-independent: the Stone Font, the Listening Pit, the Rite Circle, the Voice Ring, the Shatter Array and both gates.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: A Voice Ring of totems at radius 3 around a Pulse Resonator is opt-in — a scattered heap still works, but counts at most five voices.

pages.title: Stone Font
pages.text:
The starter rite.\
A font and four chalk marks asks for cobblestone at 4 Pulse a second.\
Brace it and bring Earth for stone.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Add Fire and Water for obsidian at 24 Pulse a second, or feed 250 mB water and 250 mB lava for the same obsidian at 6.

pages.title: Listening Pit
pages.text:
Stone, four Anchor Stones, chalk to the middle, a Resonance Mesh, an Ancestral Cache and Earth in reach.\
Metals come out raw or as grit; gems skip the fire.\
A sample on top is a filter, never an ingredient.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Mining stays cheaper; the pit buys walking away from it.

pages.title: One voice, one so...
pages.text: Earth is the Drumheart. Fire is the Ember Horn (furnace fuel, up to 20/s). Air is the Wind Harp (altitude, sky, weather). Water is the Wave Drum (adjacent or piped). Spirit is the Wake Bell (nearby deaths). Loom is the Loom Anchor (1/s per distinct voice). Pulse Cairns hold 4,000 each, five to a column.

pages.title: Way Gate and Far ...
pages.text:
The Gate Drum stays the portable way into the March.\
A Way Gate is a five-by-five frame, 20 Pulse a traveller, linked within 64 blocks.\
A Far Gate is taller, braced, Loom-voiced, linked with a Gate Sigil, 120 Pulse a traveller.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Players, mobs and items all pass. `/tribalpower gate list`.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text: Open this stage in the quest screen. Complete its required tasks, claim the reward and seat its Strand token at the Tension Post. Check that the matching notch lights.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes show the current ingredients; the Spirit Codex covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and read the machine's diagnostic message.
